nodes.description: Immutable public state variable holding the initial interest rate (1e18 scale) of BetaInterestModelV1.
Immutable state variable holding the lower bound applied to the computed target interest rate.
Immutable state variable holding the upper bound applied to the computed target interest rate.
Immutable state variable (0..1e18) controlling how aggressively the interest rate moves per day.
Constructor validating min/max rate ordering and adjust rate bound, then initializing all immutable state variables.
External view function computing the next interest rate from previous rate, available liquidity, outstanding loan and time passed.
Arithmetic operation: totalAvailable + totalLoan, computing total liquidity (unchecked overflow potential pre-0.8 semantics / bounds assumptions).
Arithmetic operation: totalLoan * 1e18, scaling the loan to compute utilization rate.
Arithmetic operation: adjustRate * cappedtimePassed (and the 0.7e18 branch multiplication) used to derive multRate.
Arithmetic operation: upMaxRate * upScale * cappedtimePassed used to derive the increased multRate.
Arithmetic operation: prevRate * multRate / 1e18 producing the target rate.
Arithmetic operation: 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18, computed in the high-utilization branch.
Constructor parameter _initialRate supplying the initial interest rate.
Constructor parameter _minRate supplying the minimum interest rate bound.
Constructor parameter _maxRate supplying the maximum interest rate bound.
Constructor parameter _adjustRate supplying the aggressiveness factor.
getNextInterestRate parameter prevRate, the current interest rate.
getNextInterestRate parameter totalAvailable, current available liquidity.
getNextInterestRate parameter totalLoan, current outstanding loan.
getNextInterestRate parameter timePassed, seconds since the last rate rebase.
Local variable totalLiquidity = totalAvailable + totalLoan; zero value returns prevRate.
Local variable utilRate = totalLoan * 1e18 / totalLiquidity, the utilization ratio.
Local variable cappedtimePassed = min(timePassed, 1 days), capping the elapsed time.
Local variable multRate, the multiplier applied to prevRate depending on the utilization branch.
Local variable downScale = (0.7e18 - utilRate) * 5 used in the 50-70% utilization branch.
Local variable upScale = (utilRate - 0.8e18) * 5 used in the 80-100% utilization branch.
Local variable upMaxRate derived from adjustRate, scaling the upward rate move.
Local variable targetRate = prevRate * multRate / 1e18 before clamping.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _initialRate is assigned to the immutable state variable initialRate.
Constructor parameter _minRate is assigned to the immutable state variable minRate.
Constructor parameter _maxRate is assigned to the immutable state variable maxRate.
Constructor parameter _adjustRate is assigned to the immutable state variable adjustRate.
Constructor require(_minRate < _maxRate) gates execution based on the _minRate parameter.
Constructor require(_minRate < _maxRate) gates execution based on the _maxRate parameter.
Constructor require(_adjustRate < 1e18) gates execution based on the _adjustRate parameter.
Parameter totalAvailable feeds the arithmetic addition producing totalLiquidity.
Parameter totalLoan feeds the arithmetic addition producing totalLiquidity.
Result of totalAvailable + totalLoan is stored in local totalLiquidity.
Parameter totalLoan is multiplied by 1e18 in the utilization computation.
Result of totalLoan * 1e18 divided by totalLiquidity yields utilRate.
Local totalLiquidity is the divisor used to compute utilRate.
Parameter timePassed is capped by Math.min into cappedtimePassed.
State variable adjustRate feeds the multiplication with cappedtimePassed.
Local cappedtimePassed is multiplied by adjustRate to derive multRate.
Result of the adjustRate * cappedtimePassed arithmetic is stored in multRate.
utilRate feeds the downScale arithmetic in the 50-70% utilization branch.
downScale contributes to the multRate value in the 50-70% utilization branch.
utilRate feeds the upScale arithmetic in the 80-100% utilization branch.
State variable adjustRate is used in 1e36 / (1e18 - adjustRate) - 1e18.
Result of the upMaxRate arithmetic is stored in local upMaxRate.
upMaxRate is multiplied in the upward multRate computation.
upScale is multiplied in the upward multRate computation.
cappedtimePassed is multiplied in the upward multRate computation.
Result of the upMaxRate * upScale * cappedtimePassed arithmetic is stored in multRate.
Parameter prevRate is multiplied by multRate to compute the target rate.
Local multRate is multiplied by prevRate to compute the target rate.
Result of prevRate * multRate / 1e18 is stored in local targetRate.
Utilization branch selection in getNextInterestRate determines whether the decrease multiplier is computed.
Utilization branch selection in getNextInterestRate determines whether the upMaxRate arithmetic branch executes.
State variable minRate is read to clamp the returned rate.
State variable maxRate is read to clamp the returned rate.
Local targetRate is clamped by Math.min/Math.max and returned as the function result.
